what: FAILED_RUN_ID provenance and non-empty invariant are unspecified
scenario_or_breakage: The sentinel path is defined only as main-agent-ci-fix-$FAILED_RUN_ID.attempted, so an implementer could use an empty or stale state value and create main-agent-ci-fix-.attempted that collides in a reused IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR
suggested_fix: Revise Step 8+ to state FAILED_RUN_ID is the ship-pr-state.sh FAILED_RUN_ID key written by ship-pr.sh record_ci_counters after ci-wait.sh in ci-initial or ci-merge, sourced from ci-status.sh extracting the GitHub Actions run id; require non-empty numeric value or skip to the existing Exit 3 user-bail path without writing a sentinel

what: Counter initialization and read/write idiom are underspecified
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says skip if the counter reaches 3 and later says the 4th bail falls through, but it does not define missing-file initialization, non-numeric handling, or whether the check is before or after increment; an implementation could accidentally skip the 3rd attempt or keep retrying on malformed count content
suggested_fix: Mirror the existing Exit 6 counter style explicitly: read missing or non-numeric count as 0, skip when count is >= 3, otherwise write count+1 before the fix attempt; state that the cap is inclusive of three main-agent attempts and the 4th first-fixer-non-health arrival falls through

what: Sentinel or counter write failure handling is not specified
scenario_or_breakage: The failure-mode section requires fail-closed write order, but the control flow does not say what to do if touch/temp-mv of the sentinel or counter fails; proceeding to the main-agent fix after a failed write can recreate the infinite loop the sentinel is meant to stop
suggested_fix: Treat sentinel or counter write failure as a skip of the new main-agent path: append a Tool Failures or warning entry if possible, do not attempt the fix, and fall through to the existing Exit 3 user-bail flow; if IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR itself is missing or invalid, bail or stall explicitly rather than continuing
